name: stir-the-pot-on-exercise-ball
instructions:
1. Assume a kneeling position with your forearms resting on a physioball.
2. Extend each leg and utilize a shoulder width (or slightly wider) stance.
3. Slowly rotate the arms in a clockwise fashion for the assigned number of repetitions.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions in the opposite direction (counter clockwise).
